//: The buildings on the map: Hardman and Jacobs, Jett Hall, and Corbett Center.
Facts come from the NMSU Office of Space Planning. Building codes come from the NMSU Registrar.
To add a building, run tools/NmsuScraper.java with its name, or copy the example below into
the buildings list and fill in real info. Also add a matching description in
dateAdded is the day it first went in. dateUpdated is the day it last changed.
lastInputSource says who wrote it last: "scraper" (copied from NMSU) or "human" (one of us).
scraperStamp is a fingerprint of what the scraper wrote. Edit any line of a building and it
stops matching, so the next scraper run marks the building "human" and never overwrites it
again. Nothing to remember: just edit. Run the scraper with -force to take NMSU's version back.
The example itself is not on the map. Only objects inside buildings are.

properties.name: Building Name
properties.floorsSource: Where the floor count came from
properties.codeSource: Where the building code came from

properties.name: Hardman and Jacobs Undergraduate Learning Center
properties.source: NMSU Office of Space Planning, Buildings layer (property 323)

properties.source: NMSU Office of Space Planning, Buildings layer (property 189)
